articles.summary: Calabrio is a workforce management platform where QA is an add-on module. Intryc is built from the ground up for AI-powered QA, evaluating 100% of interactions with no configuration overhead. For QA alone, Intryc is faster, cheaper, and more accurate.
articles.title: Intryc vs Calabrio: Dedicated QA vs Legacy WFM Bundle

articles.summary: EvaluAgent is a UK-based QA platform strong in contact centers. Intryc offers higher accuracy guarantees, auto-generated training simulations, faster setup, and works across any helpdesk. For most teams wanting more than evaluation alone, Intryc delivers more value.
articles.title: Intryc vs EvaluAgent: Which AI QA Tool Is Better?
